name: chatty-fm-agent
description: A private AI radio companion for music, voice, and daily context.
author: Natalie

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @chatty/server & npm run dev --workspace @chatty/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @chatty/shared && npm run build --workspace @chatty/server && npm run build --workspace @chatty/web && node scripts/build-speech-helper.mjs
scripts.desktop:package: npm run build && electron-rebuild -f -w better-sqlite3 -v 43.1.1 -a arm64 && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config.npmRebuild=false

extendInfo.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Chatty uses your location to provide accurate local weather and radio context.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Chatty uses your microphone to turn spoken requests into text.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Chatty uses macOS Speech Recognition to transcribe your music requests.
